Digital Product Owner

City

Florence

State/Province

Kentucky

Overview:

About Chemille®
Chemille® is Celanese’s AI-powered digital assistant that helps customers, engineers, designers, and material specialists identify the right polymers and engineered materials based on application requirements, certifications, performance characteristics, and industry-specific needs. The platform delivers intelligent material recommendations, product information, technical resources, and direct access to Celanese experts. [askchemille.com]

As Chemille evolves into a next-generation intelligent platform, we are seeking a Digital Product Owner to own the end-to-end product roadmap for Chemille’s AI-powered ecosystem while leading the vision, strategy, and delivery of AI capabilities that drive business value and user engagement.  The ideal candidate will have strong Product Management fundamentals with a hand-on understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and workflow automation.

Responsibilities:

Product Vision & Strategy
• Define and communicate the product vision, goals, and success metrics for Chemille
• Develop and maintain a multi-year product roadmap, aligned with business priorities and user needs
• Balance short-term deliverables with long-term strategic direction

Backlog Management
• Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility
• Write clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and requirements for development teams
• Continuously groom and refine the backlog to keep it actionable and up to date

Stakeholder Management
• Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, users, and the development team
• Gather and synthesize input from stakeholders into product decisions
• Manage expectations around scope, timelines, and trade-offs

Delivery & Execution
• Work collaboratively with Developers, UX/UI Designers, AI Engineers, and Business Stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of business requirements
• Participate in Sprint ceremonies and deliver User Stories within cycle time expectations

Qualifications:

•  Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar role, ideally for a website or digital product
•  Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
•  Demonstrated understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic AI.
•  Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements documentation
•  Comfort with usage analytics and KPI measurement
•  Excellent prioritization, negotiation, and stakeholder communication skills
•  Familiarity with Azure DevOps (ADO), Figma, or similar tools to manage the software development lifecycle
•  Basic understanding of UX/UI and web technologies to enhance site usability and user satisfaction
•  Knowledge or experience with Chemical or Material Engineering is a plus, but not required
